speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I do understand that we do include capital income once every five years in terms of our calculation for our Gini coefficient.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: If we can do it once every five years, why not do it every year?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: As I have said just now, collecting data on income other than work is always fraught with issues, not just for us but for other countries as well.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: But we are continuing to see how the data can be better captured.
